definitions.meaning: The vector space Sym^d(W^*) of binary forms of degree d for a two-dimensional complex vector space W.
The pairs (A,B) satisfying Res(A,B)=1 and ell(AB)=1.
The complement of the resultant and multiplication-hyperplane divisors in P(V_r) x P(V_s).

statement.latex: \begin{gathered}r,s\ge1,\qquad \Phi_{r,s}(A,B)=(AB,\operatorname{Res}(A,B)),\\\det D\Phi_{r,s}=(-1)^{s(r+1)}(r-s)\operatorname{Res}(A,B)^2.\\r\ne s\Longrightarrow \widetilde X_{r,s,\ell}\longrightarrow U_{r,s,\ell}\text{ is a finite \acute{e}tale }\mu_{|s-r|}\text{-torsor},\\\deg(\widetilde X_{r,s,\ell}\to\{C\in V_{r+s}:\ell(C)=1\})=|s-r|\binom{r+s}{r},\\\mathcal R_{r,s},\mathcal S_{r,s,\ell}\text{ prime}\Longrightarrow\operatorname{Cl}(U_{r,s,\ell})\simeq\mathbb Z/|s-r|\mathbb Z.\end{gathered}
statement.natural: Let r,s>=1 and choose the standard monomial coefficient orders on V_r, V_s, and V_{r+s}. For Phi_{r,s}(A,B)=(AB,Res(A,B)), det D Phi_{r,s}=(-1)^{s(r+1)}(r-s)Res(A,B)^2. In particular, if r!=s, Phi_{r,s} is etale on the coprime locus {Res!=0}. For nonzero ell in V_{r+s}^*, if r!=s, projectivisation is a finite etale mu_{|s-r|}-torsor from the normalized slice tilde X_{r,s,ell} to U_{r,s,ell}; the induced multiplication map has generic degree |s-r| binom(r+s,r); and, if the resultant divisor R_{r,s} and multiplication-hyperplane divisor S_{r,s,ell} are prime, Cl(U_{r,s,ell}) is isomorphic to Z/|s-r|Z.
quantifiers: for every pair of integers r,s >= 1
for every nonzero ell in V_{r+s}^* for the slice conclusions
